title: Time off
description: Holidays, training days and closures nobody can be booked in

help.title: About time off
help.overview: Time off removes a dentist from booking for a while; a location closure removes everyone at that location.

sections.title: On this page
items: Time off can't cover existing appointments: the error lists them so they can be moved first.
Once created, the window is fixed. To change it, delete it and add a new one.
